note: The Wikipedia article on Wilson primes states 'It has been conjectured that infinitely many Wilson primes exist' but provides no attribution or date for when this conjecture was first posed. The primes 5 and 13 were known from Mathews (1892), and 563 was discovered in 1953, but the formal conjecture about infinitely many does not have a documented origin date.
